item.text:
Audited all 57 Roman verse lines in [bhai-ka-laasha.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/22ce58ed67fb4f0ba752861990e98cb5/src/data/lyrics/bhai-ka-laasha.md) against the Urdu. Corrected wording mismatches, phonetic spellings, nasal markers, and capitalization. The Urdu text, stanza structure, and metadata were preserved.

The readings of `گردے سکینہ` and `ان شب شب ماتم حسینا` remain uncertain and need editorial review.
